title: turath-catalog editions
description: One row per edition (a printing, lithograph, thesis or manuscript copy) of a work.

edition_id.description: Stable id: `e_` + first 10 hex digits of sha1 of the edition's label within its category.

title_ar.description: Title as given on this edition.

label_ar.description: Composed label «title - author - editor - publisher place», the library's citation form.

kind.description: printed, lithograph, manuscript (a copy of a manuscript), thesis (university thesis) or offprint (a journal article).

editors_ar.description: Editors and other contributors, `;`-separated, in order (details in edition_editors).

edition_statement_ar.description: Edition statement when it is not a plain number (e.g. «طبعة خاصة»).

volumes.description: Number of volumes of the printed set, as the edition or its catalog record gives it.

pages.description: Number of printed pages, as the edition's catalog record gives it.

n_files.description: Number of scan files (volumes as scanned) in the library.

size_bytes.description: Total size of the scan files in bytes (exact sizes per file in edition_files).

title_page_read.description: True when the title page of this scan was read by eye and the label made from it.

wikidata_qid.description: Wikidata item of the same edition (the item that carries this Shamela book id, P12239).

ext_ids.description: `;`-separated `scheme:id`: `waqfeya` = waqfeya.net book id of a record for this very scan (linked by exact file size); `shamela` = Shamela book whose card describes this same edition.

field_sources.description: JSON object: column → source of its value (title_page, imprint_page, catalog_record, shamela_card, shamela_author, file_label, user).

confidence.description: `high`: title page read by eye; `medium`: values from a size-linked catalog record or the same-edition Shamela card; `low`: from the library's label only.
